pages.title: Understanding the Curse
pages.text: The $(curse)Khamsin Curse$() is an ancient affliction that spreads through cursed zones. It progresses through $(l)five stages$(), each more debilitating than the last.$(br2)Your $(gold)Ankh$() meter protects you. When it depletes in cursed areas, the curse takes hold.

pages.title: Curse Stages
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Stage I:$() Minor fatigue$(li)$(l)Stage II:$() Reduced strength$(li)$(l)Stage III:$() Hunger and weakness$(li)$(l)Stage IV:$() Severe debilitation$(li)$(l)Stage V:$() Near death$(br2)Remove the curse with $(item)Ancient Script of Wisdom$() or the $(item)Feather of Ma'at$().

pages.title: Ancient Script of Wisdom
pages.text: A scroll inscribed by $(deity)Thoth$() himself. Reduces Khamsin curse by one stage. Useful for managing the affliction when a full cure is unavailable.

pages.title: Feather of Ma'at
pages.text: The sacred feather of $(deity)Ma'at$(), goddess of truth and justice. Its divine power can cleanse the Khamsin curse from your soul.
